model_output.verdict: A strong Army logistics leader’s resume with measurable maintenance and people-management results.
write_up: Your resume is strong because it connects Army leadership to work an operations recruiter can recognize: managing people and equipment, planning logistics, and improving vehicle readiness. I read it for operations supervisor roles, and a recruiter would have good reason to move it forward.

The vehicle readiness line is the model: it gives the starting point, the improvement, and the changes you made to get there. Your inventory and personnel lines also make the responsibility concrete. Your transition to civilian operations is named right at the top.

Let's make the field-exercise support more concrete and add what you taught the junior mechanics. Your resume isn't likely to be the main thing standing between you and a call back; the competition for a particular role matters too.
